key_insights: Revenue decreased by 33.1% in 2026-09 compared with the previous month.
Saturday generated the highest observed sales volume among all weekdays.
Peak transactional activity occurred between 18:00 and 19:00.
UPI was the dominant payment channel, representing 72.5% of recorded orders.
Laptops was the highest-performing category, contributing 15.2% of total product revenue.
Observed daily revenue on festival dates was 11.0% lower than on non-festival dates.
Rainy days were associated with 37.2% higher observed revenue compared to dry days.
